Log in with the institutional identity provider.

Panel: [Settings](/docs/reference/cli/panels/settings/).

## Usage

```text
huron login [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option      | Type | Default | Description                    |
| ----------- | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------ |
| `--device`  | flag |         | Use the device code flow.      |
| `--browser` | flag |         | Use a browser on this machine. |
